svg.title: Why ROBIN has three modules
svg.text: each program writes its own scripts for each step
three modules in one core; one adapter for each outside system

svg.text: Runs any model the same way
Tests models against expert labels; picks optimal clips to label
Trains a small head on the program's labels
the new head joins the models
